description: Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.

b.request: Return one row for stations whose average `bandusagepct` (non-null, per telescope) exceeds the mean `bandusagepct` across all non-null telescope rows: the mean of those stations' averages, and the mean of each station's average minus that global mean, both unrounded
b.sql: WITH global AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS gmean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS savg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation) SELECT AVG(s.savg) AS mean_station_avg, AVG(s.savg - g.gmean) AS mean_diff_from_global FROM station_avgs s CROSS JOIN global g WHERE s.savg > g.gmean;

a.request: Average the bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of the telescopes at each observatory station, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the average bandwidth usage over all telescopes (each telescope counting once). For the stations whose average is above that baseline, return one row with two unrounded values: the mean of those stations' averages, and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline.
a.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS base_bw FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), above AS (SELECT s.avg_bw, s.avg_bw - b.base_bw AS excess FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.avg_bw > b.base_bw) SELECT AVG(avg_bw) AS mean_above_station_avg, AVG(excess) AS mean_excess_over_baseline FROM above;

c.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is above average, what is their mean bandwidth usage, and how far above average are they on average? Ignore missing usage values, and give both figures unrounded in a single row. Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the mean bandwidth usage over all individual telescopes.
c.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_usage FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) SELECT AVG(s.avg_usage) AS mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(s.avg_usage - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_above_average FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_usage > o.overall_avg;

d.request: Compare each observatory station's average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`, ignoring missing values) with the mean bandwidth usage across all individual telescopes.
d.sql: SELECT t.observstation, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS station_avg_bandusagepct, (SELECT AVG(t2.bandusagepct) FROM telescopes t2 WHERE t2.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) AS overall_avg_bandusagepct, AVG(t.bandusagepct) - (SELECT AVG(t2.bandusagepct) FROM telescopes t2 WHERE t2.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL) AS diff_from_overall FROM telescopes t WHERE t.bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY t.observstation;
